settings.search.detail.builtin_body.desk: Built-in free engine with no API Key required. Use the switch on the list page to control whether it takes part in search. It ignores params passthrough and does not support advanced search syntax such as site:.
Built-in engine names are fixed; create a custom engine if you need your own name

Placeholders go inside string values; write "{{count}}" (with quotes) for integer fields and it is converted to a number at run time
settings.search.help.title: Usage guide
settings.search.help.toggle.title: Enable switch
settings.search.help.toggle.body: Only engines with the switch on take part in search; by default only the built-in DuckDuckGo is enabled. If every engine is off, search returns a notice instead of silently falling back.
settings.search.help.priority.title: Engine priority
settings.search.help.priority.body: List order is the order engines are tried during a search; if a request fails (for example an invalid key or a timeout), the next enabled and fully configured engine is tried automatically.
settings.search.help.custom_engine.title: Templates and custom engines
You can edit a preset engine's request template on its detail page and restore the defaults; you can also create a custom engine and describe any search API with a template. The agent passes request parameters at call time (GET appends them to the query string / POST merges them into the request body); the API Key is injected from the local keystore only at send time, and the configuration contains only the {{apiKey}} placeholder.

You can edit a preset engine's request template on its detail page and restore the defaults; you can also create a custom engine by pasting a curl command and describe any search API with a template (the {{query}}/{{count}}/{{apiKey}}/{{baseUrl}} placeholders are supported). The request body defaultBody is optional; leave it empty to let the agent pass parameters at call time. Placeholders go inside string values; write "{{count}}" (with quotes) for integer fields and it is converted to a number at run time.
settings.search.help.test_quota.body.des: The "Test search" on the detail page sends a real request to the engine's endpoint and may consume its quota or incur charges.
settings.search.help.key_security.title: Key security
settings.search.help.key_security.body: The API Key is stored only in the local secure keystore; it never enters conversation records and is not uploaded by cloud sync.
settings.search.validation.api_key_requi: Enter an API Key (leaving it empty will not change the saved key)
settings.search.validation.headers_not_o: Headers must be a JSON object
settings.search.toast.toggle_failed.mobi: Failed to toggle the enabled state
settings.search.empty.no_engine_selected: No engine specified. Choose one from the search settings list.
settings.search.empty.engine_missing.des: The engine does not exist; it may have been deleted.
settings.search.curl.section_desc.deskto: Paste a curl command (supports -X / -H / -d / --data-raw / -G); any plaintext key found is replaced with {{apiKey}} and written to the secure keystore when you save.
settings.search.curl.key_detected.deskto: A key was detected and filled into the API Key field below; it is written to the secure keystore when you save.
